## User Stories

### Add Error Rate Column to Service Table
- **Story:** As a DevOps engineer, I want to see error rates in a dedicated table column so that I can quickly scan for problematic services
- **Priority:** P0
- **Story Points:** 2
- **Acceptance Criteria:**
  - [ ] Error rate column added to existing table structure
  - [ ] Column displays percentage with % symbol
  - [ ] Column header shows 'Error Rate'
  - [ ] Column aligns with existing table styling

### Implement Error Rate Threshold Visualization
- **Story:** As a DevOps engineer, I want visual indicators when error rates exceed thresholds so that I can quickly identify issues
- **Priority:** P0
- **Story Points:** 3
- **Acceptance Criteria:**
  - [ ] Error rates above threshold are highlighted in red
  - [ ] Error rates below threshold have normal styling
  - [ ] Threshold value is configurable
  - [ ] Tooltip shows threshold value on hover

### Create Error Rate Formatting Service
- **Story:** As a developer, I want a consistent way to format error rates so that values are displayed uniformly across the application
- **Priority:** P1
- **Story Points:** 2
- **Acceptance Criteria:**
  - [ ] Format error rates to 2 decimal places
  - [ ] Handle null/undefined values gracefully
  - [ ] Provide utility function for percentage calculation
  - [ ] Add unit tests for formatting edge cases

### Implement Real-time Error Rate Updates
- **Story:** As a DevOps engineer, I want error rates to update automatically so that I always see the latest data
- **Priority:** P1
- **Story Points:** 3
- **Acceptance Criteria:**
  - [ ] Error rates update when new metrics are received
  - [ ] Updates occur without page refresh
  - [ ] Update frequency matches API polling interval
  - [ ] Visual indicator shows when updates occur


## Non-Functional Requirements
- Performance: API response times < 200ms
- Security: Follow OWASP Top 10 guidelines
- Scalability: Support horizontal scaling
